cd-bot-tip-on: High API limits are active for your account: listing is up to 10× faster.
cd-hero-description: Save thousands of audio, image or video files, with their licenses, into a folder on your computer. Pause whenever you like, even close the tab: it picks up exactly where it stopped.
cd-hero-step3-text: files are saved straight to it
cd-footer-privacy: Files go straight from Wikimedia to your computer. Nothing is uploaded anywhere else.
cd-browser-unsupported: This browser cannot save into a chosen folder. Please use Chrome, Edge or another Chromium-based browser.
cd-404-text: The address may be mistyped, or the link may be out of date.
cd-resume-title: Welcome back. Pick up where you left off?
cd-discard-confirm: Discard the saved session? Already downloaded files stay on disk, but progress is forgotten.
cd-failed-title: {{PLURAL:$1|$2 file needs|$2 files need}} another try
cd-pausing-note: Finishing downloads in progress and writing the README. This can take a few seconds.
cd-finish-failed: {{PLURAL:$1|$2 file just needs|$2 files just need}} another try.
cd-step1-text: Type a Category name, with or without “Category:”. Use a prefix such as es:wp: to change wiki.
cd-tab-hint: Press Tab to use the suggestion.
cd-top-category-tip: The files directly in the category you chose, not those of its subcategories
cd-nothing-selected: Select at least one category to download.
cd-step2-text: Pick a folder on your computer. CategoryDownloader creates a sub-folder named after the category.
cd-running-note: A download is running (step 3). You can prepare the next one.
cd-sidecars-label: Save .json metadata file next to each download
cd-sidecars-note: Always on. Contributors must be credited via backlink, user's name and license: each .json holds all three.
cd-filter-count-note: The file count above is for the whole category: with a filter, fewer files will be downloaded.
cd-step3-text: Speed, what was just saved, what comes next and the final summary appear here.
cd-step3-placeholder: Press “Choose folder & start” in step 2 and the download shows up here.
cd-error-already-running: A download is already running in another tab.
cd-concurrency-warning: Wikimedia asks for at most 2 downloads at once. More may get you slowed down or blocked.
